_readme: CareerNexus — Team VertexSquad.
THIS IS THE FILE TO EDIT to change the Team section.
TO CHANGE A WORK TITLE: edit that person's "title" field. It is shown
exactly as written here, so expanding one is just typing the fuller
version in:
{ "name": "Yash Barkale", "title": "Backend Developer" }
An empty title renders a muted "Work title to be added" placeholder
rather than a guess. Titles are never invented — if one is missing, it
is because nobody has supplied it yet.
TO CHANGE A BIO: edit that person's "bio" field. Keep it to one
sentence — the card clamps at three lines. An empty bio renders
nothing at all, so the card falls back to just name and title.
TO REORDER: move an entry in "members". The order in this file is the
order shown on the page.
TO ADD OR REMOVE A MEMBER: add or delete an entry in "members", giving
any new one a unique "id".
WHAT THIS SECTION SHOWS: name, work title and a one-line bio. No
photos, skills, profile links or personal contact details — that is
deliberate, not unfinished. Everyone reaches the team through the
the contact form, which goes to the address in CONTACT_TO
(backend/.env).
